accuracy = max(accuracies, default=60)
    intervals = calendar + repeat
    if not intervals:
        return None, None
    overall = max(intervals) + accuracy

evidence.reason: The timer-bound calculation adds only AccuracySec and never reads RandomizedDelaySec. systemd applies RandomizedDelaySec to timer elapse, so a timer such as OnUnitInactiveSec=1min, AccuracySec=1s, RandomizedDelaySec=10min can start up to about 661s after the prior inactive state while this code returns 61s. Any caller using that bound can time out or fence before the next invocation is allowed to start. Parse RandomizedDelaySec (default 0) and include its maximum in the overall and repeat bounds, or reject such timers before fencing.
